senses.gloss: Fracas,Ⓒs.ⒹkalahaH.

Fraction,Ⓒs.ⒹBinnaM, BAgaH, apUrRAMkaH, rASi-BAgaH.
Ⓝ[Fraction]al,Ⓒa.ⒹapUrRa, BAgika (kI f.), BAgin.
Fractious,Ⓒa.ⒹkalahakArin, SIGrakopa; vAmaSIla.

Fracture,Ⓒs.ⒹBaMgaH, BedaH, vidAraRaM, trowanaM, viBaMgaH, viBedaH.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹBaMj 7 P, Bid 7 P, vidF 10; See Break.

Fragile,Ⓒa.ⒹBaMgura, BaMgaSIla, Bidura, Bidelima, suKaBedya, suBaMga; vinaSvara, kzayin.
Ⓝ[Fragil]ity,Ⓒs.ⒹBaMguratA, kzayitA, BiduratA.

Fragment,Ⓒs.ⒹKaMqaH-qaM, SakalaH-laM, BAgaH, aMSaH, dalaM, BinnaM; ‘in a thousand f(ragment)s’ sahasraDA.
Ⓝ[Fragment]ary,Ⓒa.ⒹapUrRa, BAgin, KaMqayukta.

Fragrant,Ⓒa.ⒹsuraBi, sugaMDi, suvAsa, Amoda-parimala-vat, suvAsika, sAmoda, parimalo-dgArin, gaMDayukta, gaMDavat; tikta, kazAya.
Ⓝ[Fragrant]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹsavAsaM, sAmodaM, sagaMDaM.
ⓃFragrance,Ⓒs.ⒹAmodaH, parimalaH, sOraBaM, sOraByaM; gaMDaH, vAsaH, suvAsaH, sugaMDaH.

Frail,Ⓒa.ⒹBaMgura, naSvara, DvaMsin, anitya, asTAyin, kzayin, sadyaHpAtin, kzaRa-BaMgura-viDvaMsin.
Ⓝ[Frail]ness, [Frail]ty,Ⓒs.ⒹBaMguratA, naSvaratvaM, kzayitA, &c.
Ⓑ
 2 dozaH, sKalitaM, pramAdaH.

Frame,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓvi-, rac 10, vi-DA 3 U, kxp c., kf 8 U, Gaw c. (Gawayati), saMvi-DA, samA-DA, nirmA 2 P, 3 A.
Ⓑ
 2 nibaMD 9 P.
Ⓑ
 3 sadfSIkf; ‘f(rame) in the mind’ manasA ciMt 10 or kxp c., citte kf.
Ⓔs.ⒹnirmARaM, raca-naM-nA, GawanaM-nA.
Ⓑ
 2 ADAraH, upazwaMBaH; Ava-raRaM, koSaH, AvezwanaM.
Ⓑ
 3 SarIraM, dehaH, gAtraM, vapus n., kAyaH, aMgaM; ‘f(rame) of body’ deha-baMDaH; ‘of a hardy f(rame)’ vajradehin, siMha-saMhanana.
Ⓑ
 4 BAvaH, vftti f., sTiti f., daSA, avasTA; ‘joyous f(rame) of mind’ AnaMdavfttiH.
Ⓑ
 5 AkAraH, rUpaM, Akfti f., rIti f., saMsTAnaM.

Franchise,Ⓒs.ⒹpOrajanADikAraH.
Ⓑ
 2 mukti f., mocanaM, svADInatA.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓmuc 6 P.
Frangible,ⒶSee Fragile.

Frank,Ⓒa.Ⓓnizkapawa, sarala, fjumati-budDi, udAra, nirvyAja, spazwa-sPuwa-vAdin, asaMvfta, avakra, amAya, nirvyalIka, dakziRa, agUQaBAva; akapawa, avyAja, amAyin; ‘f(rank)-hearted’ vimalAtman, udAraDI; SudDAMtaHkaraRa.
Ⓝ[Frank]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹnirvyAjaM, nizkapawaM, amAyayA, saralaM.
Ⓝ[Frank]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹamAyA, fjutA, nizkApawyaM, OdAryaM, dAkziRyaM, sAralyaM, akApawyaM, &c.
Frank-incense,Ⓒs.ⒹkuMduraH-ruH, kuMduH-daH, mukuMdaH, pAlaMkI.

Frantic,Ⓒa.Ⓓunmatta, madavikzipta, vyastacitta, saMrabDa; ‘f(rantic) with rage’ kroDonmatta, kopo-nmAdin.
Ⓝ[Frantic]ally,Ⓒadv.Ⓓunmattavat, sonmAdaM, sasaMraMBaM.
Ⓝ[Frantic]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹunmAdaH, vyAmohaH, cittaviplavaH, unmattatA, vAtulatA, citta-viBramaH.

Frater,Ⓒs.ⒹparivrAj m. yati m.
Ⓑ
 2 baMDu m., bAMDavaH.

Fraternal,Ⓒa.ⒹBrAtrIya, BrAtfsaMniBa, BrAtranu-rUpa.
Ⓝ[Fraternal]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹBrAtfvat, sodaravat.

Fraternity,Ⓒs.ⒹBrAtftvaM, sOBrAtraM.
Ⓑ
 2 samAjaH, saMsargaH, sAhityaM, baMDutA.
ⓃFraternize,Ⓒv. i.ⒹBrAtfvat saMmil 6 P or saMyuj pass. or ekIBU or sannipat 1 P.

Fratricide,Ⓒs.ⒹBrAtfGAtakaH, BrAtfGAtin m.
Ⓑ
 2 BrAtfvaDaH-hatyA-GAtaH.

Fraud,Ⓒs.ⒹkapawaH-waM, CalaM, kEtavaM, mAyA, vyAjaH, kUwaM, vaMcanaM-nA, upaDiH, pratAraRaM-RA, vipralaMBaH, Cadman n., daMBaH, kusfti f., nikfti f.
ⓃFraudulent,Ⓒa.Ⓓkapawin, savyAja, SaWa, DUrta, mAyin, vaMcaka, pratAraka, vipralaMBaka, kApawika-CAdmika (kI f.), kapawa in comp.; ‘a f(radulent) plan’ kapawaprabaMDaH.
Ⓝ[Fraudulent]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹCalena, sakapawaM, savyAjaM, mAyayA, DUrtavat, samAyaM, sakEtavaM.

Fraught,Ⓒa.ⒹDurya, DurIRa, BArAkrAMta.
Ⓑ
 2 A-saM-paripUrRa, AkIrRa, A-saM-kula, garBa-Avaha- in comp.; ‘f(raught) with danger’ anarTAvaha.
Fray,Ⓒs.ⒹkalahaH, kaliH, yudDaM, dvaMdvaM.
